critique: The render now clearly reads as fiery falling sparks: it has a black background, dense yellow/orange/red embers, visible glow, and the t4 frame shows the particle mass descending. However, it remains a tight, centered column rather than the wider, more dispersed falling-sparks shower indicated by the preset thumbnail. The source and trail are still compact, with small bead-like particles and insufficient lateral spread; the field should occupy substantially more width and persist farther downward.

suggestions.why: Widen the emitter so sparks originate across a broader horizontal area instead of a narrow centered plume.
Increase directional spread to create a more naturally dispersed shower and break up the rigid vertical column.
Extend particle lifetime so the descending spark field forms a longer, more convincing falling trail.
Make individual glowing embers more substantial at frame scale, closer to the visible spark size in the preset thumbnail.
